events.name: Vegas Golden Knights at Toronto Maple Leafs

headlines.description: — Mark Stone had two goals and an assist and the Vegas Golden Knights beat the Maple Leafs 6-3 on Friday night in
headlines.shortLinkText: Golden Knights beat Maple Leafs 6-3 in Marner’s emotional Toronto return

events.name: Tampa Bay Lightning at Chicago Blackhawks

headlines.description: — Dominic James scored in the fifth round of a shootout and the Tampa Bay Lightning made it 15 straight games without a regulation loss, outlasting the Chicago Blackhawks 2-1 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lightning beat Blackhawks 2-1 in shootout in their 15th straight game without a regulation loss

events.name: St. Louis Blues at Dallas Stars

headlines.description: — Jason Robertson scored his 30th goal of the season with one minute to play to lift the Dallas Stars to a 3-2 victory over the St. Louis Blues on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Robertson scores 30th goal with a minute left to lift Stars over Blues 3-2

headlines.description: — Owen Tippett had his second career hat trick and the Philadelphia Flyers handed the NHL-leading Colorado Avalanche their fourth loss in five games, 7-3 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tippett has 2nd career hat trick, Flyers beat NHL-leading Avs 7-3

headlines.description: — Hendrix Lapierre ended a 90-game goal drought, Alex Ovechkin had an empty-netter and the Washington Capitals beat the Calgary Flames 3-1 on Friday night to end a four-game losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hendrix Lapierre ends 90-game goal drought in Capitals’ 3-1 win over Flames

events.name: New Jersey Devils at Vancouver Canucks

headlines.description: — Cody Glass had two goals and an assist, Lenni Hameenaho scored his first NHL goal and the New Jersey Devils beat the Vancouver Canucks 5-4 on Friday night to extend their Western Canada winning streak to three.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cody Glass has 2 goals and an assist in Devils' 5-4 win over Canucks

events.name: New York Rangers at San Jose Sharks

headlines.description: — Macklin Celebrini had two goals to end his longest drought of the season, pacing the San Jose Sharks to a 3-1 win over the New York Rangers on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Celebrini scores twice, Sharks beat Rangers 3-1

headlines.description: — Cutter Gauthier had a goal and an assist, Lukas Dostal made 21 saves and the Anaheim Ducks beat the Seattle Kraken 4-2 on Friday night for their sixth straight victory following a nine-game losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ducks beat Kraken 4-2 for 6th straight victory following 9-game losing streak
